dialogue_texts: Hmph! I suppose you didn't need a lot of purification.
You're much more durable than you look, my Majesty.
Purification is a concept for those who still have an end in sight.
For me, your ritual was merely a pleasant way to pass a few minutes of eternity.
Eternity, eh? The Houraisan Dynasty seems to talk big.
Still, if you're looking for something that actually smells "off", don't waste your time here.
I'm tracking the "glohm". It lacks the elegance I expect from a world-ending threat.
Not here. However, the air is starting to rot over toward the Amber Woods.
It's a stagnant, heavy feeling - sort of like your attitude.
Rotting air and heavy atmospheres? It sounds like a stage fit for a moonlit stroll.
I shall depart for the woods at once.
